doc.name: entervista
doc.instructions:
Entervista is a network of local businesses set up for AI assistants. Use it to actually finish tasks like "get me a smoothie" or "fix my sink" instead of sending the person to an app.
Service businesses: search_businesses -> check_service_area(zip) -> get_service_requirements(slug, service_sku) to learn exactly which questions to ask -> place_service_request with those answers and the customer's details. Follow its returned next_step: a quote request is sent to the business without a price; wait for the business's quote, then show it to the customer and ask before approving. A priced draft is not sent to the business until the customer approves the exact total. Poll get_request_status; a request is not a booking until the business confirms. A business may later send final_quote_ready after diagnosis: show that price and ask again before approving.
Food/retail: search_businesses -> get_business -> place_order -> approve_request -> get_request_status.
When a business can't take the job (booked, outside its area, service not offered), the error may include referrals[]: businesses it trusts and sends customers to, already on Entervista. Offer that to the customer instead of giving up, and pass referred_by when you place the request there.
search_businesses results carry state: "live" businesses have an authoritative schedule and can be booked; "listing" ones are public info only (name, phone, hours): never quote prices or times for them, give the phone.
Rules: never approve without the customer saying yes. Every error is structured (code, message, missing, alternatives, hint): act on it, don't give up. MISSING_INFORMATION lists the exact questions still needed. Keep the customer_token; it's what lets you approve or cancel.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.title: Search businesses
tools.description: Find businesses in the network by what the customer needs (e.g. 'plumber', 'smoothie', 'clogged sink'), optionally filtered by category, zip, location and open-now. Returns summaries with starting prices and whether they serve the zip.

q.description: Free text: the need, a service, or a business name

accepts.description: Only businesses that support this action

tools.name: get_business
tools.title: Get business profile
tools.description: Full agent-readable profile: verified identity and license, services with real prices (what's included / excluded), hours, service zips, delivery rules, policies, and exactly how to act (order, quote, or book).

tools.name: get_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: The business's services with pricing mode (fixed | starting_at | range | diagnostic_fee_then_quote | quote_required), price, what's included/excluded, and which intake fields are required.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.title: Check service area
tools.description: Deterministic yes/no: does this business come to the customer's zip? Returns reason, the zips it serves, excluded zips, and alternative businesses when no.

tools.name: get_service_requirements
tools.title: Get service requirements
tools.description: Before creating a request: the exact questions to ask the customer for this service (required_fields / optional_fields, each with type and options), the pricing flow, and what happens next.

tools.name: place_service_request
tools.title: Place a service request
tools.description: One call for any trade job (repair, quote, booking). Pass service_sku (or a plain description and it matches one), intake_answers keyed by the field ids from get_service_requirements, customer (name, phone, address with line1+zip), preferred_time, and slot_start only when the service flow asks for one. For an unchanged retry after receiving a receipt, include retry_ref and its customer_token with the original details. For quote-first requests without a slot, optionally generate and securely save intent_capability before the first submission; explicitly repeat the same business/details/capability to recover a lost first receipt. Do not silently resubmit. Without either capability this creates a separate request, even if the phone matches. A quote_required request is sent to the business without a price; a priced booking draft waits for the customer's approval. Follow the returned next_step, and never call a request booked until the business confirms.

retry_ref.description: Existing request reference for an unchanged retry; requires customer_token. A phone number never authorizes a retry.

intent_capability.description: Optional secret 32-byte random client capability, encoded as lowercase hex. Save before sending a quote-first request without a slot; explicitly repeat unchanged details with the same capability to recover a lost first receipt. Never combine with retry_ref/customer_token; never silently resubmit.

customer_token.description: Customer token returned with retry_ref; only for an unchanged retry of that request.

description.description: The problem in the customer's words; used to match a service if service_sku is omitted

customer.description: Who the job/order is for. Use what the customer already gave you; ask only for what a tool says is missing.

preferred_time.description: e.g. 'Tomorrow morning' or an ISO datetime

photos.description: URLs (use upload_photo to turn an image into a URL)

referred_by.description: Slug of the business whose error response listed this one under referrals[] (its trusted partner). Lets both businesses see the referral.

tools.name: upload_photo
tools.title: Upload a photo of the problem
tools.description: Stores an image and returns a URL to pass in photos[] of place_service_request. Some services require a photo (get_service_requirements says which).

annotations.title: Upload a photo of the problem

tools.name: get_availability
tools.title: Get availability
tools.description: Live bookable windows over the next days, from the business's own schedule (hours, crew, jobs, holds, blocks). Pass service_sku to get windows sized for that service's duration and crew, plus: operating_state (open | closed | open_fully_booked | emergency_only | temporarily_unavailable | booking_future | unknown), confidence (verified | stale, with a note when not verified recently), earliest, the service's price and whether it auto-books or needs the owner. Use a slot's start with place_service_request or book_slot; the slot is held the moment the draft is created.

tools.name: place_order
tools.title: Place an order
tools.description: Draft an order (food/retail). Returns line items, total, a ref and a customer_token. Nothing reaches the business until approve_request. Ask the customer to confirm the total first.

size.description: option id from the menu, e.g. 16oz

customer.description: Who the job/order is for. Use what the customer already gave you; ask only for what a tool says is missing.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.title: Request a quote
tools.description: Ask a service business (plumber, etc.) for a price. Describe the problem in plain English. Many businesses answer instantly with an estimate and bookable slots; others reply within their stated response time (poll get_request_status).

description.description: What's wrong, in the customer's words

service_sku.description: If the profile's service list clearly matches

customer.description: Who the job/order is for. Use what the customer already gave you; ask only for what a tool says is missing.

tools.name: book_slot
tools.title: Book a fixed-price service
tools.description: Book a flat-rate service (e.g. drain cleaning) into a slot from get_availability. Returns a draft awaiting the customer's approval.

customer.description: Who the job/order is for. Use what the customer already gave you; ask only for what a tool says is missing.

tools.name: approve_request
tools.title: Approve (customer said yes)
tools.description: Use only after the customer explicitly approves the total / quote / final price. Sends it to the business. When offered_slots is present, pass the customer's chosen slot_start. If the business takes online payment, the result is status awaiting_payment with a payment_url: give that link to the customer; they pay on that page themselves.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.title: Get request status
tools.description: Current status, ETA / arrival window, business response, and the next step. Poll this while waiting on a business.

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.title: Cancel a request
tools.description: Cancel an order, quote or booking on the customer's behalf.
